title: GTA 6 Black Friday 2026: Storage, Controllers and the Game
desc: GTA 6 Black Friday 2026 guide: what's worth buying for a 212 GB game (PS5 SSD, Xbox expansion card, controllers), what to skip, and how to spot a real deal.
lede: GTA 6 launches a week before Black Friday (November 27, 2026) and Cyber Monday (November 30). If you're shopping for it, this is what's worth watching. We'll update this page with the best deals we can verify.
sections: GTA 6 is up to 212 GB. A 2 TB PS5 SSD with a heatsink or an Xbox storage expansion card are the upgrades that actually fix "storage full". Try the free fixes first.
